'''''Song of the Dongtha Slayer''''' was a musical piece often sung in [[Ancient Askajian]], containing 722 known verses. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] offered to sing it to the caravan leader [[Borno]].<ref name="TG">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>
